image.prompt:
Product photograph of one isolated object, shot from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER ANGLE: the camera is well above the object and tilted down about 30 degrees, so the top of the object is clearly visible along with its front and one side. Not a straight-on elevation.

The object: Standalone single-storey AIS mobile network shop building, detailed front elevation with a full glazed frontage and glass door under a bright green and white fascia carrying the AIS wordmark on a backlit sign, green promotional banner panels set flush beside the entrance and display counters faintly visible inside, plain warm cream painted side and rear walls in a single flat off-white tone clearly lighter than the background, with a service door, flat roof with a low parapet and roof-mounted air-conditioning condensers Materials: bright green printed acrylic sign face and white laminate panel at the front, aluminium glazing and plate glass, flat warm cream painted render on side and rear walls, galvanised roof plant.

Form: build the object from a few simple, chunky, closed volumes. Prefer solid panels over lattice, mesh, grilles or perforated screens; keep any openings few, large and clearly separated. No thin spindly protrusions, no wires, no chains, no fringes, no lace, no fine filigree, no dense repeated slots or cut-outs. Keep the silhouette simple and readable from every side. Keep the object's SHAPE simple; richness must come from the surface finish, wear and materials rather than from intricate geometry. The object is still photoreal and highly detailed in its texture -- only its form is simple.

Framing: long-lens near-orthographic perspective, minimal foreshortening. The object is perfectly centred and occupies about 75% of the frame height, with clear empty margin on all four sides. The whole object is in frame; nothing is cropped.

Background: completely flat seamless MID-DARK neutral grey (#606060), distinctly darker than every part of the building so the object reads as a clean cut-out against it. The object floats in empty space against an infinite seamless backdrop with nothing underneath it. There is no surface for it to rest on and nothing for it to cast a shadow onto. No floor, no ground plane, no horizon line, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient.

Lighting: flat even studio illumination from all sides, soft and shadowless, like a lightbox. No strong key light, no rim light, no coloured light, no specular blowout, no dramatic highlights. Colours must read as true albedo.

One object only, nothing else in frame. No people, no hands, no other props, no packaging, no watermarks, no measurement annotations, no arrows, no borders, no drop shadow. Apart from the building's own signage described above, there is no other text or lettering anywhere in the frame.

Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, clean and undamaged geometry, realistic materials and surface wear. Not stylised, not cartoon, not low-poly, not a 3D render preview, not a wireframe.

review.critique: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.91 -- up from 0.87 with the owner's five corrections each measured against a rectified elevation: side door 0.5 m from the rear corner, white fascia to the coping, sign centred, poster pictures, two bays a side. 1400/16000 triangles, 12/12 draw calls, 7/8 materials, 12/16 unique geometries, 5 textures, factory ~60 ms.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope built at 8.00 x 4.60 x 6.96 m against the declared 8 x 4.6 x 7: no canopy, so the shell face is pushed to z 3.06 and the sign face lands at 3.46. Front, -X and roof elevations rectified at 150 px/m (scratch/_ais/front_rect_grid.png, side_rect_grid.png, roof_rect_grid.png). Full-height parapet ring to the coping on all four sides as the rectified -X wall shows; roof units under the 4.60 coping. check-coplanar clean at 0.001 m; derived 8-box compound coverage 0.9993, overshoot 0.0725.
featureReviews.notes: Third build, moved from the img2threejs generator factory onto the shared retail template the seven sibling shops use, so the depth ordering and draw-call accounting are the module's.

featureReviews.evidence: White board y 2.80..4.58 across the whole front (rectified rows 0..270) with a 0.30 m +X return, its top 2 cm under the coping -- the owner's 'white part needs to extend to the roof'; the previous build stopped at 4.25 under a cream strip. Green lightbox 6.15 x 0.95 m (rectified 6.15 x 0.93) centred on the board at x 0, y 3.69, 12 cm proud, the mark 1.85 x 0.64 m centred on it (sign/fascia.png from the mask-cleaned rectified mark). Front render (review/beauty-000.png) shows equal white margins above and below the sign.
featureReviews.notes: The rectified plate has the sign 0.4 m lower than centre; centred on the owner's instruction and recorded in assumptions.

featureReviews.evidence: Glazing x -3.78..3.30 (rectified 0.22..7.30 m), head 2.70, transom 2.23, sill 0.30 over the cream plinth; door bay -1.00..0.80 (rectified 3.0..4.8) with the meeting stile at -0.10; ONE mullion each side at -2.45 and 2.05 (rectified 1.5 and 6.0 m), so two bays a side -- the owner's correction from three. Left leaf hinged at -1.00 with its pull bar at the meeting stile; right leaf fixed in the frame and glazing merges with its own bar. Aluminium #B6BABB frame.
featureReviews.notes: The right leaf is fixed geometry because the template hangs one leaf; the pair reads as a double door with both bars at the centre.

featureReviews.evidence: The glazing image (sign/glass.webp, world [-3.78, 0, 3.30, 2.70] at 150 px/m) carries the plate's own rectified poster bays in the two outer bays (world -3.78..-2.45 and 2.05..3.30, sill to head) -- green with the white promotional picture in the lower half -- and the siblings' plain cool tint in the inner bays and the door. Rendered posters at azimuth 0 and 45 show the picture; the turntable gate passed at all four azimuths.
featureReviews.notes: The pictures are the 1024 plate's pixels and are soft close up; a poster is a flat board flush behind the pane so a flat picture is the right delivery, unlike an interior view.

featureReviews.evidence: Rectified -X elevation: one cream door 1.3 x 2.15 m at 0.5..1.8 m from the REAR corner. Built at z -3.00..-1.70, recessed 0.10 m (shell boxes leave the pocket), the leaf in the wall material with an aluminium reveal and lever; the previous build had it mid-wall. Visible in review/beauty-315.png.
featureReviews.notes: Not mirrored onto the unobserved +X wall.

featureReviews.evidence: Two instanced split condensers left-rear (x -2.55, -1.50) and one right-rear (1.65) at z -2.05, 0.85 scale so their lids sit at 4.59 under the coping, and a hooded duct run between them in the same galvanised spangle; deck at 3.95..4.01 inside the full-height ring.
featureReviews.notes: The plate shows the units partly above the coping; the declared 4.60 envelope wins.
